hook: Fragmented islet clusters survive low oxygen and controlled diabetes in mice for over 5 weeks
summary: Passing native islets through a mesh produced smaller clusters that tolerate low oxygen better and had less central necrosis after implantation. Rat versions in a thin alginate device controlled blood sugar in immune-competent diabetic mice for over 5 weeks at a modest dose. The study is short, in mice, and uses rat tissue, so human benefit is untested.
title: Engineered endocrine objects tolerate hypoxia in macroencapsulation devices and enable subcutaneous engraftment in diabetic mice
